FAQ

Common Questions

What are your timings?

Listings show that we are open daily from about 10:30 AM to 11:30 PM. Timings can change, so please call 098736 61133 to confirm before you visit.

Do you have vegetarian options?

Yes. Google lists vegetarian options, and our menu has veg and non-veg choices. Ask us on WhatsApp if you need help choosing.

Do you deliver?

Yes, delivery is listed on our Zomato page. You can also call or WhatsApp 098736 61133 to ask.

Is it good for kids and families?

Yes. We have a kids' menu, high chairs and board games, and we host kids' birthday parties.

What is the average cost?

Around ₹400 to ₹600 per person.

Do you take group or birthday bookings?

Yes. WhatsApp us in advance with your date, time and number of guests.

Can I book a table?

Yes. Use the form above or WhatsApp us with your date, time and number of guests.
